recipe.visualDefinition: A centered typographic composition on a heavily weathered, parchment-like background featuring a bold, distressed slab-serif title framed by thin ornamental rules and a clean secondary subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the heavy, textured title and the clean, smaller subtitle
Symmetry established by the central horizontal axis and framing rules
Integration of text and background through shared distressing and grit
coreInvariants: Parchment-style background with vignetted grunge edges
Horizontal rule dividers with a central decorative flourish
Dark mahogany or burnt umber color for all graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized typography occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold slab-serif title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large central title, moves up/down to the framing rules, then settles on the subtitle below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space at the top and bottom to emphasize the central message.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value background with high contrast, low value foreground elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and traditional serif
letterConstructionRules: Title uses extra-bold weight with thick, blocky serifs
Subtitle uses a standard weight serif with high legibility
Intentional erosion and 'ink-bleed' texture applied to the larger glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Distressed edges on the title characters to mimic old woodblock printing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rugged, heavy display face with a clean, traditional text face.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal lines with a central diamond or scroll flourish

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif structure for the title.
Classic serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image of aged, yellowed parchment paper with heavy grunge textures, coffee-like stains, and darker vignetting around the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, distressed slab-serif title in the center in dark brown. Place thin decorative horizontal rules above and below the title. Add a smaller, clean serif subtitle below the bottom rule.

verificationChecks: Is the title text visibly distressed?
Is the background texture consistent with aged paper?
Is the color palette limited to earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the title font
Spacing between the rules and text
mustRedesign: Specific wording of the original text

avoid: Perfectly sharp edges on the display font

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the grunge texture doesn't make the subtitle unreadable.
Verify the 'burnt' color of the text matches the edge vignetting.
Confirm the rules have a vintage ornamental feel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-texture parchment base, center a heavy slab-serif title with erosion effects, frame it with thin decorative rules, and anchor it with a clean serif subtitle in a matching dark earth tone.
